name: sdl3-only-platform
classification: Platform consolidation and scaled-pointer correctness fix; no measured speedup claim.
status: Local Linux acceptance complete; cross-platform and default GPU backend acceptance pending. Not published.
adaptation: Adapted the upstream runtime/build cleanup to CCB; retained CCB render caches, native Lua Platform v1, shaders and Android integration.
changes: Remove SDL2 runtime alternatives, audio backend, FindSDL2 modules and four obsolete ImGui SDL2 backend files.
Use SDL3 for CMake, Make, vcpkg/MSVC and active desktop release jobs; retain curses/headless entry points.
Keep constant USE_SDL3 build markers for existing cache compatibility; no first-party dual-backend conditional paths remain.
Reuse pinned Linux SDK setup and extracted macOS universal SDK setup; preserve all ten active release artifact names.
Reject explicit SDL2 tiles requests early and let localization-only Make goals avoid SDL dependency discovery.
Retire already-disabled legacy WebAssembly/MXE recipes; document old developer containers as terminal-only.
Propagate SDL_SOUND to native test consumers so audio regression cases are compiled and executed.
Invert CCB manual presentation rectangle for desktop pointer coordinates at integer display scales.
Read retired graphics option IDs without exposing or serializing them; keep active graphics settings serialized.

build.configuration: Ninja Multi-Config Release; clang; TILES/SOUND/Lua Platform v1 ON; TRACY/LOCALIZE OFF; private focused native acceptance target.
build.linkage: ldd and owned process mappings contain only SDL3 libraries; no missing dependency or SDL2 library.
build.version_note: Existing worktree Git-version lookup emits HEAD-HASH fallback; commit and binary hashes identify this build.

native_regression.harness: Private deferred CMake include links test_support_sources.txt plus the four source files to cataclysm-tiles-common. TESTS is OFF for the game build.
native_regression.standard_reproduction: Configure a normal TILES/SOUND/TESTS build, build cata_test-tiles, then run the recorded filter/seed/order with a fresh user directory.
first_failure_and_repair: Initial native run: 45 cases, 43 passed and 2 failed; 4 assertions failed. Logs/XML retained.
Real SDL3 bug: SDL_RenderCoordinatesFromWindow did not invert CCB manual integer-scaled final blit; 2x/4x pointer coordinates were incorrect.
Invert get_display_buffer_render_rect from logical window coordinates through drawable pixels to display-buffer pixels; Android letterbox handling remains unchanged.
Expanded existing pointer regression to scales 1/2/4 and exact/3-pixel remainder borders for both text and map windows.
Corrected new legacy-options test: hidden retired IDs are read but intentionally omitted from existing serialization; active SCALING_MODE remains serialized.

headless.configuration: HEADLESS ON; TILES/SOUND/CURSES/Lua Platform OFF; Release; TESTS OFF.
headless.limitation: Affected boundary compilation only; no full headless link or runtime test.

cases: CMake rejects SDL2 before compiler discovery

commit_splitting.basis: Additions plus deletions from baseline to final, prohibited build cache excluded; no intermediate churn counted.
commit_splitting.reason: Most churn removes mutually exclusive legacy backend code and build paths. Keep implementation, build routing and regression tests coherent in one commit; keep documentation and acceptance record in the second. Do not create inconsistent intermediate states to reach the line-based reference.

next_exact_action: With a future source PR, run the affected Linux pinned-stack, Windows MSVC/vcpkg, macOS universal and Android gates; diagnose preserved Vulkan GPU-submit failure separately before default-backend release acceptance.
